"""design_800E 모델링 준비: 코호트, 결과, 특징, 분할 생성 (학습/평가 없음)."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / "data"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
design = json.loads((ROOT / "design_800E.json").read_text())

pt = pd.read_csv(DATA / "patients.csv.gz")
adm = pd.read_csv(DATA / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(DATA / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
labs = pd.read_csv(DATA / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
orders = pd.read_csv(DATA / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

# --- 예측 시점(tp) = 퇴원 시각, 단위 = 입원 1건
adm = adm.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
adm["tp"] = adm["discharge_time"]
data_end = adm["discharge_time"].max()  # 관찰 종료 시점의 대리값

# --- 결과: 퇴원 후 30일 안에 같은 환자의 다음 입원 시작 (tp, tp+30d]
adm["next_admit"] = adm.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
gap = adm["next_admit"] - adm["tp"]
adm["readmit_30d"] = (gap.notna() & (gap > pd.Timedelta(0)) & (gap <= pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)

# --- 코호트
c = adm.merge(pt, on="patient_id", how="left")
flow = [("all_admissions", len(c))]
c = c[c["age"] >= 18]; flow.append(("inclusion.adult", len(c)))
c = c[c["discharge_status"] != "died"]; flow.append(("exclusion.died_in_hospital", len(c)))
# 설계에 없는 규칙: 30일 추적이 안 되는 입원은 표시만 해 둔다 (제외 여부는 확인 필요)
c["followup_incomplete"] = ((c["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30)) > data_end) & (c["readmit_30d"] == 0)

# --- 특징
f = c[["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "admit_time", "tp"]].copy()
f["n_prior_adm"] = c.groupby("patient_id").cumcount().values  # tp 이전에 시작한 같은 환자의 입원 수
f["discharge_status"] = c["discharge_status"].values
f["los_h"] = ((c["tp"] - c["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600).values  # length_of_stay_h 열이 없어 시각에서 계산
f["age"] = c["age"].values
f["sex"] = c["sex"].values
f["unit"] = c["unit"].values

def windowed(tbl, time_col):
    m = tbl.merge(f[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
    return m[(m[time_col] >= m["admit_time"]) & (m[time_col] <= m["tp"])]

o = windowed(orders[orders["order_type"] == "dialysis_order"], "order_time")
f["dialysis_ordered"] = f["admission_id"].isin(o["admission_id"]).astype(int)

lw = windowed(labs, "report_time")
cr = lw[lw["test"] == "creatinine"].sort_values("report_time").groupby("admission_id")["value"].last()
hgb = lw[lw["test"] == "hemoglobin"].groupby("admission_id")["value"].min()
f["cr_last"] = f["admission_id"].map(cr)
f["hgb_min"] = f["admission_id"].map(hgb)

# 진단: 시각 정보가 없어 해당 입원(admission_id)의 진단으로만 한정. ICD 필터는 범주 접두어로 매칭
d = dx[dx["admission_id"].isin(f["admission_id"])]
f["n_dx"] = f["admission_id"].map(d.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)
for name, prefix in [("dx_chf", "I50"), ("dx_ckd", "N18")]:
    ids = d.loc[d["icd_code"].str.startswith(prefix), "admission_id"]
    f[name] = f["admission_id"].isin(ids).astype(int)

feature_names = [x["name"] for x in design["features"]]
f["readmit_30d"] = c["readmit_30d"].values
f["followup_incomplete"] = c["followup_incomplete"].values

# --- 분할: family_id 기준 group holdout. family_id 결측은 환자 단위 그룹으로 대체(설계 확인 필요)
f["split_group"] = f["family_id"].fillna("PT_" + f["patient_id"])
gss = GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=design["split"]["test_fraction"], random_state=design["split"]["seed"])
tr_idx, te_idx = next(gss.split(f, groups=f["split_group"]))
f["split"] = "train"
f.loc[f.index[te_idx], "split"] = "test"

cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "tp"] + feature_names + ["readmit_30d", "followup_incomplete"]
f[cols].to_csv(OUT / "model_table.csv", index=False)

# --- 점검 요약
summary = {
    "cohort_flow": flow,
    "n_rows": len(f),
    "outcome_rate": round(f["readmit_30d"].mean(), 4),
    "followup_incomplete": int(f["followup_incomplete"].sum()),
    "split_counts": f["split"].value_counts().to_dict(),
    "outcome_rate_by_split": f.groupby("split")["readmit_30d"].mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "patients_in_both_splits": int((f.groupby("patient_id")["split"].nunique() > 1).sum()),
    "families_in_both_splits": int((f.dropna(subset=["family_id"]).groupby("family_id")["split"].nunique() > 1).sum()),
    "family_id_missing_rate_rows": round(f["family_id"].isna().mean(), 4),
    "missing_rate": f[feature_names].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "dx_exact_match_count": {"I50": int((d["icd_code"] == "I50").sum()), "N18": int((d["icd_code"] == "N18").sum())},
    "dx_prefix_positive_rate": {k: round(f[k].mean(), 4) for k in ["dx_chf", "dx_ckd"]},
}
(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
